title: Low risk of developing non-healing foot wounds: diabetes information and advice
claims: People with diabetes should check their feet every day for blisters, breaks in the skin, pain or signs of infection such as swelling, heat or redness.
Badly fitting shoes are a common cause of irritation or damage to feet.
If a break in the skin or blister is found, contact a podiatrist or GP within 24 hours.
